The [[Moocher]]s of [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] spoke a '''language'''. The language was primarily conveyed through gestures, though it also included barks and whistles. The language's gestures caused many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to view the Moochers as "fidgety."<ref name="CatCW" />
